observed_failure: The program prints a plausible numerical result and Validation: PASSED, then aborts with free(): invalid next size and double free or corruption diagnostics; exit 134.
finding: For n=1031 and four ranks, the ceil partition has 258,258,258,257 bodies, but every MPI_Allgatherv receive count is set to 258*3 doubles. The last sender supplies only 257*3 doubles and the declared receive extent ends three doubles past the n*3 global buffers. This violates the collective count contract and is consistent with the retained heap-corruption abort.
interpretation: Pre-existing uneven-partition MPI count/buffer defect. A printed validation pass does not override abnormal process termination. Retain failed external validation without retry.
investigation: Static source/receive-count inspection and retained exclusive stderr/exit status; no new program execution.
